parsed.summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of RenameIndex() crashing when an unnamed index is moving backward and forward. The change is minimal and focused on the intended fix.

issues.description: The code could be slightly more readable by adding comments to explain the logic of restoring the old auto-generated name.
